observations: bcm_phy_ack_intr reads MII_BCM54XX_ISR; the source comment identifies this as clearing pending interrupts.
bcm_phy_config_intr reads ECR, reads ISR via ack, and writes ECR to mask or unmask interrupt delivery.
bcm_phy_handle_interrupt reads ISR and IMR, masks inverted IMR bits, and triggers the PHY state machine when an unmasked source is present.
bcm_phy_enable_apd writes shadow SCR3 when dll_pwr_down is true, then writes the APD shadow after changing APD enable bits and single-link-pulse wake behavior.
bcm_phy_set_eee reads/writes Clause 45/MMD EEE control and advertisement registers.
PHY_BRCM_AUTO_PWRDWN_ENABLE, PHY_BRCM_EN_MASTER_MODE, and PHY_BRCM_IDDQ_SUSPEND are retained driver flags.
MII_BCM54XX_ISR, IMR, ECR, APD, SCR3, and EEE constants are retained source-backed register families.
BCM54213PE config_init dispatches through bcm54xx_config_init and bcm54213pe_config_init -> bcm54210e_config_init.
bcm54xx_config_init writes IMR, performs RGMII/LED/PTP/WOL-adjacent configuration, and reads WOL_INT_STATUS as an interrupt/wakeup side-effect surface.
The BCM54213PE driver table includes config_intr, handle_interrupt, suspend, and resume callbacks.
bcm54xx_suspend reads WOL_INT_STATUS, may enable wake IRQ, writes BMCR_PDOWN directly, then may set IDDQ.
bcm54xx_resume may disable wake IRQ, clear IDDQ, run genphy_resume to clear BMCR PDOWN, wait 40us, optionally soft-reset, then rerun bcm54xx_config_init.
Prior accepted checkpoint deferred APD, EEE, interrupt, lifecycle, and MAC/phylink pending explicit side-effect and restore scope.
This task refines that deferred set rather than selecting a runtime task.

family_side_effect_classification.reason: Source-backed via bcm_phy_enable_apd, but the useful path changes SCR3/APD shadow bits and wake behavior. It is lifecycle/power policy, not a direct read-only link-not-ready discriminator.
Source-backed via bcm_phy_set_eee and genphy_config_eee_advert, but it changes EEE feature enable/advertisement state. It requires an ownership and restore contract before hardware.
bcm_phy_ack_intr documents that reading MII_BCM54XX_ISR clears pending interrupts. A one-off ISR read could consume evidence and is not an acceptable discriminator without interrupt ownership.
Source-backed via bcm54xx_config_init and bcm_phy_config_intr, but it writes masks/control state and crosses into interrupt delivery ownership.
bcm_phy_handle_interrupt reads ISR/IMR and may trigger phy_trigger_machine. That is driver interrupt ownership, not a bounded link-not-ready feature discriminator.
bcm54xx_config_init and suspend read WOL_INT_STATUS and may emit wake events. It is wake/lifecycle state, not a direct packet-readiness path.
bcm54xx_iddq_set writes TOP_MISC IDDQ bits under PHY_BRCM_IDDQ_SUSPEND. This requires lifecycle ownership and paired restore before use.
bcm54xx_suspend writes BMCR_PDOWN directly and warns against read/modify/write. It would intentionally power down the PHY, the opposite of a feature-led link-ready path.

family_side_effect_classification.family: BMCR powerdown exit and soft reset
family_side_effect_classification.reason: bcm54xx_resume clears powerdown through genphy_resume, waits 40us, may soft reset, and reruns config_init. That is a full lifecycle sequence requiring explicit ownership and terminal classification.

The accepted frontier already exercised the narrow config_init-derived MII_CTRL1000 master-mode path and then one BMCR autoneg restart. Replaying broader config_init writes would repeat or broaden closed work.
No source-backed low-power/lifecycle item here gives MAC or phylink ownership. Crossing into MAC/phylink would broaden beyond this PHY source checkpoint.
Pure reads are available but already accepted as timeout/link-not-ready: BMSR link false, BMSR autoneg-complete false, ANLPAR 0x0000, MII_STAT1000 0x0000, and MACB_NSR_LINK false.

inspection_summary.pause_rationale: The remaining source-backed surfaces are either lifecycle/power/interrupt write ownership, interrupt or wake reads with side effects, MAC/phylink boundary work, or same-shaped link/autoneg polling already closed by accepted hardware evidence.
